title: Contact my local office internationally | Internal Revenue Service
text: Skip to main content Contact my local office internationally English Español 中文 (简体) 中文 (繁體) 한국어 Русский Tiếng Việt Kreyòl ayisyen More In Help Interactive Tax Assistant Tools Report fraud Tax scams Identity theft Notices and letters Appeals Frequently asked questions Accessibility Contact your local IRS office Contact an international IRS office Tax topics Other languages International services If you are a taxpayer with specific individual or business account questions you should contact the International Taxpayer Service Call Center by phone or fax. These account questions can relate to various topics such as overpayment status, balances owed, and correspondence received regarding international tax forms. Telephone assistance While our telephone assistors can help answer these questions, there are some questions that are too complex for us to address. To find resources to assist you with these more complex tax topics, visit Find information on complex tax topics . Monday-Friday, 6 a.m. to 11 p.m. (Eastern time, U.S. and Canada); Tel: 267-941-1000 (not toll-free) Fax: 681-247-3101 (for international tax account issues only International live chat Live chat is for individuals with an international tax related issue. For a representative to assist you with account-related questions you must: have an active Online account for individuals Living outside the U.S. or have an international tax issue? Use the live chat to get help with most of your individual international questions. Chat with us now – we’re available online: Live chat available in English Monday-Friday: 6 a.m.-11 p.m. Eastern time Saturday-Sunday: Unavailable Chat now Tax professionals or software providers If you are a tax professional or software provider calling about an e-file issue and it is not account related, please contact the e-help office in Austin at 512-416-7750 (not toll-free). Assistors are available Monday through Friday, from 7 a.m. to 6 p.m. (Central time). Taxpayer service, formerly offered at the foreign posts of duty, is no longer available. Please send your tax forms and correspondence to the applicable address indicated below. Individual taxpayers located outside the U.S. may also contact the IRS by mail at: Internal Revenue Service International Accounts Philadelphia, PA 19255-0725 Business taxpayers located outside the U.S. may also contact the IRS by mail at: Internal Revenue Service International Accounts Ogden, UT 84201-0038 Residents of Puerto Rico and the U.S. Virgin Islands may contact the IRS toll-free at 800-829-1040 (hours of operation are 7 a.m. to 10 p.m. Monday-Friday). For face-to-face assistance information in Puerto Rico refer to Contact your local IRS office . Taxpayer Advocate Service Taxpayers living abroad : calls will be automatically routed to Hawaii or Puerto Rico depending on your location. If you select Spanish, your call will be routed to the Puerto Rico office for assistance. Mailing address: 48 Carr 165, Suite 2000 Guaynabo, PR 00968-8000 Phone: +15.15.56.46.827 (not toll-free) Fax: 304-707-9793 Email: tas.international@irs.gov Page Last Reviewed or Updated: 21-Sep-2026 Share Facebook Twitter Linkedin Print
